chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Mūsā ibn Bukayr, from ʿAlī ibn Saʿīd, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about Salat al-Layl and al-Witr during travel, in the early part of the night, when one is not able to perform it in its latter part. He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the Witr prayer, the concluding unit of the night prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed as a recommended act of worship
key_terms.فِي آخِرِهِ: in the latter part of the night
key_terms.فِي أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ: in the first part of the night
key_terms.فِي السَّفَرِ: during travel, indicating the ruling applies in a state of journeying

ai.seo_question: Can Salat al-Layl and al-Witr be performed at the beginning of the night while traveling if one cannot pray them later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning Salat al-Layl and al-Witr during travel. It indicates that if a person cannot perform them in the latter part of the night, it is permitted to perform them at the beginning of the night.
